test.create(caller)
test.create(caller::/outer::trigger)
outer.create(callee)
outer.destroy(trigger)
test.create(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::value)
test.set_value(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::value, 4)
test.create(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::copy)
test.create(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::trigger)
inner.set_value(copy, value)
inner.destroy(trigger)
test.create(/result)
test.set_value(/result, caller::/outer::callee::/inner::copy)
test.destroy(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::value)
test.destroy(caller::/outer::callee::/inner::copy)
test.destroy(caller::/outer::callee)
test.destroy(caller)
